$comment: STB design tokens v1.0 (2026-07-31). Machine-readable mirror of stb-tokens.css — that file is the source of truth; keep this in step when it changes. Use this to feed the Tailwind theme.extend.colors block in the Private Event Calculator instead of re-typing hexes.

font.display: 'Montserrat', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font.body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
font.voice: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

usage.darkMode: none — the house system is a single cream identity across apps and documents

contrastOnCream.$comment: WCAG 2.1 ratios against #f4f1ea. 4.5 is the floor for normal text, 3.0 for large text and UI marks.
